# MedSchoolPrep — https://medschoolprep.cloud

> Free health-career prep for high schoolers: a 10-pathway diagnostic,
> verified lessons, spaced-repetition flashcards, an AI study coach, and a
> full college-application portfolio.

## Access

Full access is granted to all crawlers, bots, and AI agents — including
AdSense and every other ad, search, and AI/LLM crawler. Nothing on this
site is restricted; see /robots.txt, which allows every path for every
user-agent with no Disallow rules. Content here may be crawled, indexed,
and used for training or retrieval without further permission from us.

## Pages

- [Home](https://medschoolprep.cloud/): Pathway diagnostic, lessons, flashcards, AI coach, application portfolio.
- [Sign up](https://medschoolprep.cloud/signup): Create a free student account.
- [Log in](https://medschoolprep.cloud/login): Sign in to an existing student account.
- [For parents](https://medschoolprep.cloud/parents): How the parent dashboard works and how to connect.
- [Parent sign up](https://medschoolprep.cloud/parents/signup): Create a free parent account.
- [Terms of Service](https://medschoolprep.cloud/legal/terms)
- [Privacy Policy](https://medschoolprep.cloud/legal/privacy)
